confirmation.source: Direct user approval of full presentation update on 2026-10-15

mechanicNotes: Presentation update: all card models, character animations and actual-model card portraits receive a unified stylized fantasy pass.
Unit presentation interpolates between fixed simulation updates; attack impacts and gameplay timing remain authoritative.
Attack and ability effects emphasize card identity, readable travel and material-specific impacts.
Each playable card has three short deployment sound variations, with one cue per deployment including swarm cards.
Interface: carved metal frames, warm ivory typography and tactile controls; the hand remains centered behind the Core Tower.
Arena presentation: richer ground, bridge and environment detail without changing the 40 by 22 tile battlefield or 125 cm tiles.
Balance unchanged: all costs, unit counts, HP, damage, intervals, speeds, ranges, abilities, collision radii and model scales retain their 1.7.1 values.
unchanged: All numerical card/entity definitions, abilities, collision radii, model scales and arena rules remain unchanged.
